data.title: Save Data So It Lasts
data.outcome: Trace one save and read operation to find where data stops, then confirm it remains after a refresh.
intentExamples: Keep data from disappearing after a refresh
Connect my page to a database

stages.title: Understand the path data takes
stages.action: Map the path from input through request, processing, storage, and response.
stages.evidence: You can identify which part is mainly responsible for each step.

lessons.title: Frontend
lessons.tagline: The layer people directly see, click, and type into

lessons.title: API
lessons.tagline: An agreed way for two pieces of software to request and return information

lessons.title: Backend
lessons.tagline: The server-side part people usually cannot see that handles requests and data

stages.title: Define how the front end and back end exchange data
stages.action: Set the request method, address, input, and success and error results.
stages.evidence: The front end and back end agree on the shape of the same request.

lessons.title: HTTP
lessons.tagline: Send a request and receive a response over the web

lessons.title: JSON
lessons.tagline: Represent structured data as text that programs can exchange

lessons.title: Route & Endpoint
lessons.tagline: Match a request path and method to the code that handles it

stages.title: Check that data is trustworthy before saving it
stages.action: Validate input and permissions on the server.
stages.evidence: Invalid or unauthorized data cannot be written to the database.

lessons.title: Validation
lessons.tagline: Check that incoming data has the expected shape and allowed values

lessons.title: Authorization
lessons.tagline: Decide what an authenticated user is allowed to see or change

stages.title: Actually write and read the data
stages.action: Implement writing and querying, including handling records that do not exist.
stages.evidence: After a page refresh, you can still read the content you just saved.

lessons.title: Database
lessons.tagline: Store and find application data such as users, posts, and orders

lessons.title: SQL
lessons.tagline: Ask a relational database to read or change structured records

stages.title: Use evidence to find where a failure happened
stages.action: Record server errors and show recoverable feedback on the page.
stages.evidence: You can locate a failed attempt using the request, logs, and database records.

lessons.title: Server Logs
lessons.tagline: Record what the server did so problems can be traced

lessons.title: Alert
lessons.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page
